result.title: Calibrated for Which Policy? Conformal Uncertainty for Fixed World Models Under Intervention
result.summary: Changing a deployment policy can invalidate a world model's uncertainty while leaving the physical transition mechanism and predictor unchanged. For one-step prediction, if source and target laws share the conditional mechanism $P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X)$, then the intervention is identified by the pre-outcome change of measure $w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X$. For policy-controlled dynamics this ratio factors into state-occupancy and action-propensity terms. Weighted conformal calibration transports marginal coverage to the target law; with an estimated ratio $\hat w$, $P_Q\{Y \in C_{\hat w}(X)\} \ge 1-α-TV(Q,\hat Q) \ge 1-α-E_P|w-\hat w|$. Population log-loss regret for a source-versus-target domain classifier bounds the same ratio error. If $h$ is its clipped target posterior, $ρ$ is the target-domain prior, and $Δ(h)$ is population log-loss regret, then $E_P|w-\hat w_h| \le (1/(ργ))\sqrt{Δ(h)/2}$. An exact cancellation improves the dependence from a generic odds-map bound of order $γ^{-2}$ to $(ργ)^{-1}$. Our experiments use a released DINO-feature world model and physical Franka trajectories. Under the strongest controlled state-action shift, ordinary 90% conformal sets cover 55.0%, whereas oracle and learned-ratio calibration cover 91.0% and 90.9%. The learned surrogate remains within 0.9% total variation of the target law. Calibration is relative to the deployment law: the model can remain fixed while calibration follows the intervention. We machine-check in Lean 4 the finite-support algebraic and causal identities used in the classifier-regret argument, including its coverage-composition step.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究部署策略改变后世界模型不确定性失效的问题：在条件机制 P(Y|X) 不变的前提下，用源-目标测度比 w(X)（可分解为状态占用与动作倾向）做加权 conformal 校准，将覆盖保证迁移到目标策略，并用源-目标域分类器的 log-loss regret 约束比值估计误差，在 DINO 特征世界模型与 Franka 轨迹上验证，另以 Lean 4 形式化相关代数与因果恒等式。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按策略偏移重加权、使不确定性覆盖相对于部署分布成立的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中停止/弃权决策与推理轨迹分布偏移下的置信度评价；但对象是单步预测的世界模型，与 latent 视觉推理状态本身无直接联系，迁移需较多改造。
